technology_name: NOVEL 4-DIPHENYLAMINO 3-IODO COUMARIN AND A METHOD FOR ITS ISOLATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Bio-Active Compound Isolation / Antibiotic Drug Discovery
problem_solved: Rising global bacterial resistance to standard treatments due to bacterial DNA gyrase adaptations. This technology isolates a novel coumarin compound that effectively inhibits bacterial DNA gyrase to overcome multidrug-resistant strains.
description: An advanced organic extraction and isolation protocol to yield pure 4-diphenylamino 3-iodo coumarin from the seeds of Nigella sativa, fully characterized using UV, IR, Fluorescence, ESI mass spectrometry, NMR, and GCMS arrays.
applications: Pharmaceutical drug formulation, Multi-drug resistant (MDR) bacterial therapeutics, Clinical antibiotics,Chemical reference standards.
